rules.law_name: San Francisco Rent Ordinance § 37.9C Relocation Payments
rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal, temporary capital improvement, or substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants served with eviction notices for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation are owed relocation payments based on the notice-service date. Additional payments are due for each elderly or disabled tenant or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: For notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27: $8,245 per tenant; maximum $24,733 per unit; plus $5,497 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies based on specified eviction grounds: owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation.
coverage.summary: Covers tenants evicted in San Francisco for the listed no-fault eviction grounds, with payment amounts varying by date of service of the eviction notice.

rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction: The document states that temporary capital improvement evictions lasting less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 rather than Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation

rules.law_name: San Francisco Ellis Act Relocation Payments
rules.title: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act are owed relocation payments based on the date the eviction notice is served. Additional payments are due for each elderly or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: For notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27: $11,110.05 per tenant; maximum $33,330.13 per unit; plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies when tenants are evicted under the Ellis Act.
coverage.summary: Covers San Francisco tenants evicted under the Ellis Act, with payment amounts varying by date of service of the eviction notice.

rules.title: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days
rules.requirement: For temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days, the relocation-payment amount is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 rather than San Francisco Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days, as described in the document.
coverage.summary: Covers relocation-payment amounts for short temporary capital improvement evictions lasting less than 20 days.

rules.interaction: The document says this state-law provision, not San Francisco Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C, governs relocation-payment amounts for temporary capital improvement evictions under 20 days.
rules.quoted_span: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
